observed_problems: Prior-event features were accumulated row by row after sorting by event_id inside the same availability second. Later rows at the same second could therefore treat simultaneous logs as past information while earlier rows could not, creating arbitrary order-dependent model inputs.

Position size used the pre-entry expected stop fraction, which is correct for a quantity fixed before market fill, but the liquidation test reused that expected distance instead of the actual fill-to-structural-stop distance. An inside-band entry gap could therefore hide a liquidation path or falsely classify one.
changes: Calculate prior 60-minute same-direction and prior 24-hour net issuance from timestamps strictly earlier than the current availability second; assign the same prior state to every event finalized in that second before appending that simultaneous group.
Retain the pre-entry expected stop fraction for planned quantity and leverage sizing.
Calculate a separate actual fill-to-structural-stop distance for liquidation testing, augmented by any adverse stop-gap realized loss.
Treat ENTRY_GAP_INVALIDATED_COST_ONLY as immediate zero-gross exposure with zero structural liquidation-test distance.
Record planned stop distance, actual structural stop distance, adverse realized gap loss, liquidation-test distance and liquidation distance on every account ledger row.
